title: What non-accredited buyers must receive in a Rule 506(b) offering (Rule 502(b))
rule: If a Rule 506(b) issuer sells to any non-accredited investor, it must give that buyer, a reasonable time before sale and to the extent material, the information Rule 502(b)(2) lists: for a non-reporting issuer, the kind of disclosure Form 1-A Part II requires (or a registration form's Part I if Regulation A is unavailable) and Form 1-A financial statements, plus a description of written material given to accredited investors, the resale limits, and a chance to ask questions.
changeWatch: Amendments to Rule 502(b) or to the Form 1-A financial statement requirements it points to.

sources.title: 17 CFR 230.502, General conditions to be met
sources.quote: the issuer shall furnish the information specified in paragraph (b)(2) of this section to such purchaser a reasonable time prior to sale
